mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, summary, facts_json::text AS facts_json, version, forgotten_before, covered_until_message_id, updated_at FROM conversation_memories WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_memories (conversation_id) VALUES (#{conversationId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_memories SET summary = #{summary}, facts_json = CAST(#{factsJson} AS jsonb), covered_until_message_id = #{coveredUntilMessageId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE conversation_memories SET summary = '', facts_json = '[]'::jsonb, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, forgotten_before = COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}), 0), covered_until_message_id = COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}), 0) WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
